structured.answer: From what I saw, the site doesn't calculate anything on that page yet. It's a long list of stuff like gold, ETC, corporate bonds, Israel Bonds, insurance policies, structured products, foreign-currency and dollar-linked deposits and digital wallets, and each one has a red "לא מחושב" tag. The red banner says the rules for all of them are still being checked. None of it is the S&P or Nasdaq index fund thing I actually want, so I think I can still use it for that, but I'm not totally sure.
